svg.title: ScheduledJobData on the Pecos map
svg.desc: A RETRIEVE (car on T17 to bay B21) and a MOVE_AGV planned together. The map numbers each action by its index in Schedule.nodes; the ScheduledJobData cards show which indices belong to which job.

g.text: Geometry from the Pecos YAML; occupancy, guids and the exact action order are illustrative. The shape of job A's actions matches the RetrieveJob.FromStall scenario (on 275_sunrise_b). Map labels: P17, W22, B21, C14 = node_id 17, 22, 21, 14 (P parking, W waypoint, B bay, C AGV

text.font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans', 'Segoe UI', Roboto, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

g.text: charger); T17 = tray_id 17; AGV-1 = agv_id 1; X@90 = GaragePose {node_id: X, heading: 90}, heading in degrees [-179, 180], 90 = facing -x.

g.text: Two planned jobs and one failed job. AGV-1 fetches T17 (with its car) and carries it to bay B21; AGV-2 moves out of the way. Badges on the map are positions in Schedule.nodes.
